Jg.bar_b_note: Smeared low-res ground and stretched rock-wall textures, sparse lollipop trees on a flat field and no fog, shafts or time-of-day grade sink it well below Palworld density and Valheim-class atmosphere; B's clearer aftermath storytelling does not lift the finish.

Cg.bar_b_note: The wolf's naturalistic anatomy is on the owner bar, but dull (A) or blotchy white (B) arcs and a floating, broken-looking faint keep it short of Palworld-class creature finish.

Dz.bar_b_note: A's fleece, horns and rearing hit react come close to the owner's Stormcapra bar, but faint frames hide the face (A) or float and twist the body belly-up (B), so it falls short of shipping finish.

Qp.bar_b_note: A is a smooth clay-toy boar off the naturalistic bar; B has on-style bristly fur but noisy yellow back patches and a faint that clearly hovers above its shadow.

Gd.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder with readable eyes, clean hair and beard silhouette and an olive/brown Meadows palette sits at Palworld-class character finish, although the neutral stage cannot show any lighting atmosphere.

Jx.bar_b_note: These frames are the same as Cg: a good naturalistic wolf base let down by soft purple (A) or broad white marbled (B) arcs and a faint-mid body hovering over its shadow.

top_changes.change: Ground every faint and faint-end pose: snap the body and limbs to the stage so they touch their shadow (Cg/Jx faint mid, Dz B faint mid/end, Qp B faint mid/end), and keep the face visible in Dz A's faint.

Re-author storm-arc materials on the storm creatures as thin emissive white-violet lines with tight bloom over dark fur, matching the owner's Tanglevolt/Stormursa bar, instead of soft purple smears (A) or broad white marbling (B).

Lift the Meadows aftermath sites: sharper grass and ground textures, retile the stretched stronghold wall, add grove/edge density and distance fog, and give each site its own aftermath beat (banner felled, cage open, smoke) instead of repeating the same emblem stone. Replace Qp A's clay-toy boar with a naturalistic fur mesh.
